parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 (only shape differs, 4 vs 3), the totals are 27 and 26 (a difference of 1), and neither image has a critical defect, so parity holds.

reference.summary: A cartoon beaver chef in a white hat and sun apron fries two sunny-side-up eggs in a pan on a stove with a spatula, in a bright kitchen with a smiling sun in the window; it is drawn cleanly overall, with a few contact and overlap flaws.

defects.what: The frying pan floats above the stove top instead of resting on a burner
defects.expected: The pan sits directly on a burner of the stove

defects.what: The spatula blade hovers above the pan and does not touch the eggs or the pan surface
defects.where: the spatula head near the pan
defects.expected: The spatula blade is in the pan, touching or sliding under an egg

defects.what: The tail is drawn over one of the feet, so the foot and tail shapes overlap awkwardly
defects.where: the beaver's feet and tail at the bottom
defects.expected: The tail sits clearly behind the beaver with both feet fully visible

defects.what: The arm holding the spatula is very long and thin compared with the stubby other arm
defects.expected: Both arms have similar, believable thickness and length for a beaver

defects.what: A pink heart floats above the pan with no clear purpose
defects.where: above the pan, right of the spatula
defects.expected: Decorative elements are clearly tied to the scene or are left out

attempt.summary: A large cartoon beaver chef in a white hat and apron stands behind a stove frying two sunny-side-up eggs in a pan with a spatula, in a simple kitchen; it reads clearly, but the spatula arm is confusingly built.

defects.what: The spatula arm ends in a brown blob gripping a handle that points up and away, while the spatula blade hangs below on a separate stem, so the tool's structure is confusing
defects.where: the beaver's right arm and the spatula
defects.expected: The paw holds one continuous spatula handle that leads straight to the blade

defects.what: The spatula blade hovers above the pan and does not touch the eggs
defects.where: the spatula blade above the pan
defects.expected: The spatula blade is in the pan, touching or sliding under an egg

defects.what: The pan sits on the front edge of the counter instead of on a visible burner
defects.where: the pan on the stove at the bottom
defects.expected: The pan clearly rests on a stove burner

defects.what: Small orange dashes around the pan look like stray marks rather than clear sizzle lines
defects.where: around the eggs and the pan
defects.expected: Any sizzle marks clearly read as cooking motion, or are left out

defects.what: The stove front is a plain grey panel with no visible burners or knobs that connect it to the pan
defects.expected: The stove clearly reads as a cooktop the pan is cooking on
